## View Pipedrive Lead or Deal information in WhatsApp

Rasayel's shared team inbox displays your Pipedrive leads and deals alongside WhatsApp conversations. No more switching tabs – get vital lead context instantly.

## "90% of our deals are closed on WhatsApp thanks to Rasayel"

## Your team interactions, logged in Pipedrive directly.

Rasayel automatically logs WhatsApp conversations into your Pipedrive leads and deals. Get full visibility of your team's WhatsApp interactions directly within Pipedrive.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/yobtDuOMFDcgqVSxBpKaq98GIJQ.png)

## Reports on your WhatsApp activity. Directly in Pipedrive.

Track your team's WhatsApp performance. Easily generate reports to see metrics like the number of messages sent by each team member within a chosen time period.
